decisions.decision: The plan will be revised by the Committee without outside consultants or regional agencies, with the goal of completing the Open Space and Recreation Plan prior to Thanksgiving.
decisions.quote: the committee agreed that the plan would be revised by the committee without the use of outside consultants or regional agencies.

decisions.decision: The 2018 survey will be implemented using Survey Monkey, PDF copies online, hard copies in public places, and, if possible, a mailing with the tax bills.
decisions.quote: there was a consensus the survey should be implemented using survey monkey, pdf copies online, and hard copies in public places

decisions.decision: The 2018 survey will be based on the 2008 survey so the data can be analyzed for changes.
decisions.quote: there was agreed that the 2018 survey should be based on the 2008 survey so the data could be analyzed for changes.

decisions.decision: Brandon will revise the survey on behalf of the full committee using the ideas discussed at the meeting.
decisions.quote: it was agrees that brandon would use the ideas discussed at the meeting to revise the survey on behalf of the full committee.

decisions.decision: Dave will contact the town hall about the possibility and timeline for including the updated survey with tax bills.
decisions.quote: dave will contact the town hall about the possibility /time line for including the updated open space survey with tax bills.

decisions.decision: Section leads assigned for the June 19 meeting: Dave on the Community Setting Section, Rich on Population Characteristics and on the Inventory of Lands of Conservation and Recreational Interest, and Bob on the Environmental Inventory and Analysis; the Plan Summary and Introduction will be revised toward the end.
decisions.quote: for the june 19th meeting, dave will review community setting section (rich will review population characteristics within the community setting section); bob will review the text of the environmental inventory and analysis

decisions.decision: Brandon will work on updating the mapping; the mapping requirements have not changed.
decisions.quote: brandon said the mapping requirements have not changed and that he will work on updating the mapping.

decisions.decision: Committee members are to visit each existing conservation/open space and park/recreation asset to prepare assessments; the committee will discuss this further at a future meeting.
decisions.quote: the committee will further discuss this at a future meeting.

decisions.decision: Matt Morro volunteered to complete the ADA portion of the assessment for each asset.
decisions.quote: matt morro noted he has experience/knowledge in completing ada assessments and volunteered to complete the ada portion

budget_items.topic: State grant reimbursement for open space and conservation
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A valid open space plan makes the town eligible for state grants; open space/conservation projects may be reimbursed at 64% up to a stated cap.
budget_items.quote: open space/conservation the town may be reimbursed 64% up to $400k.

budget_items.topic: State grant reimbursement for parks and recreation
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Parks/recreation projects may be reimbursed at 64% up to a stated cap; the presentation noted missed recreation grant opportunities.
budget_items.quote: parks/recreation the town may be reimbursed 64% up to $100k.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Having a plan led to a grant to acquire the Lane Property.
budget_items.quote: obtained a $270,000 grant to acquire the lane property.
